description: A young Summoner who is a member of the 31st Division of the Demon Slayers, the Sun Cuore. Sasha has shown a lot of promise on the battlefield due to her natural talent with the Summoning Arts, and has thus been gaining a lot of attention. As spunky as she is beautiful, she dreamt of becoming a Summoner since she was a child, and many have come to expect great things from her along the way. After her enlistment she never neglected her studies, and made it a point to bond with her peers. Rumor has it that the motivation behind all of her efforts is her desire for her father, a Summoner himself, to recognize her accomplishments.Sasha often volunteers to take on some of the most dangerous missions—not for personal fame or glory, but for a chance to prove herself useful. Although she did commit some rookie mistakes along the way, eventually she became an indispensable part of her squadron. Her immaturity still shows from time to time though, just like when she calls Commander Roy master instead of by his proper title.When Sasha was visiting Grand Gaia with Roy, they ran across a knight from another world and worked together against the knight's enemies without question. Unafraid of the powerful foes she was facing, she helped her comrades to stop the enemy attack, saving the knight's hometown from certain doom. Her positivity and dedication inspires all of those around her, and helps reassure the young knight in times of great distress and confusion.
summon: Don't worry, you're not alone!You've got at least one friend with you.I mean, we are friends now, right
fusion: This whole time I meant to help you,but only ended up getting help from you instead...Thanks. I'll use this power to protect you!
evolution: I want Dad to be proud of me, sure, but helping you is my priority right now.I've never wanted to help someone so much before...
